terra.problem: It claims the prison and Jerusalem offering stories belong to somebody else's letter without establishing that from Scripture.
Papa addresses the baker as both “ma'am” and “sir.” He talks to one baker at a time and calls them baker or friend.
The drawer joke relies on Papa's backstory without explaining that he spent years in a junk drawer.
Calling the question a trick that looks like a treat jokes about the lesson's own question.
The expiration-date joke targets Christ's exalted seat.
It invokes the bride as a biblical picture of the church without a reference to the other passage.
